payload.statement_nl: n² + n + 41 is prime for every natural number n.

discharges.justification: n = 40 makes 40²+40+41 = 1681 = 41² composite, a direct counterexample to the universal 'n²+n+41 is prime'.

lean.name: n2n41-plausible-search
lean.snippet: example : ∀ n : Nat, Nat.Prime (n ^ 2 + n + 41) := by plausible
lean.description: Random falsification search over the original claim (plausible; slim_check on older mathlib).

cas.name: n2n41-sympy-scan
cas.description: SymPy primality scan over n in [0, 200).

discharges.justification: A single composite value in the scanned range is an existential counterexample to the universal claim.
